description: Land  Title Settlement Department - Karamada, Udunuwara D/S DIvision, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320249
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed information about land parcels, cadastral maps, property ownership details, encumbrances, and servitude rights - all falling squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes (Type 4) which cover land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
